_comment: Evidence index — the ROOT that makes an [empirical] citation resolve to a real measurement. Before this file, lint:evidence-claims only checked that a citation-SHAPED string sat near the claim; it never checked the citation pointed at anything, and prose-citing-prose (api-notes / Pitfall #N) was accepted as evidence, so the citation graph could close into a loop with no measurement at its root. Keys are `<lab> <rung>` because a bare rung is AMBIGUOUS across labs (fluid-lab R12 != belt-lab R12) — a real collision already happened once (BELT-R8, caught by hand pre-merge). The lab suite was removed 2026-07-19 (owner ruling); these runners + NOTEBOOKs live only at the archive tag, so `measured_on` is frozen at the engine they ran on. A claim citing an entry whose measured_on != the current pin (tests/labs-certified.json) is CARRIED FORWARD, not re-verified — say so, and never re-stamp it to the current pin without re-running the measurement.
